correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs all quantifiers and boundary cases. Sparsity first forces algebraic integrality by Pinch's real-parameter theorem as restated in Fenner--Green--Homer. For a noninteger sparse parameter, Campbell's Lemma 4 excludes the open unit interval. A bad conjugate is outside the real compact set whether it is nonreal or real; in the real case irreducibility excludes the endpoints. Campbell's transfinite-diameter and integral-polynomial lemmas then give the same contradiction. The converse is exactly Fenner--Green--Homer's uniform-discreteness theorem for strong PV numbers. No finite computation is used as proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Fenner--Green--Homer's Conjecture 11.1 is broader because it concerns complex parameters, but it is conjectural in the necessity direction. Their proved necessity statement quoted from Pinch covers the real quadratic case only. The present theorem resolves the real-parameter slice without claiming the complex case.

originality.rationale: Campbell's theorem assumes total reality and its proof invokes that assumption only to place a bad conjugate on the real line before excluding it from the unit interval. The new dichotomy removes that hypothesis. Fenner--Green--Homer explicitly formulate the strong-PV converse as a conjecture and record only the real quadratic necessity, so the all-real equivalence is not implied by their stated results. Targeted published-findings searches returned no covering claim.
residual_risks: The original 1985 Pinch article was not full-text inspected in this run; the exact needed statements were cross-checked through explicit restatements in two later full-text sources.
The result does not address nonreal parameters, so the complex part of the strong-PV discreteness conjecture remains outside scope.

value.rationale: The finding removes a substantive hypothesis from a theorem published days earlier and turns sparsity itself into a Galois-reality constraint. It also yields an exact all-real characterization by strong PV numbers, extending the previously recorded real-quadratic necessity and settling the real slice of a broader current conjectural framework. This is structural rather than a routine parameter substitution.
